invariants.title: She does not move
invariants.rule: She stays pressed to the crates for the whole shot; only her eyes and her breath move.
invariants.why: Hiding is stillness. Any step toward the aisle tells the audience she has a plan before she does.

invariants.title: It is H3
invariants.rule: The take in the film is H3's.
invariants.why: H3 keeps the start frame: her face holds (0.77 against its start frame) where LTX let it drift.

invariants.title: The camera is still
invariants.rule: Almost still - a float at most.
invariants.why: The fear is in the stillness; a move would release it.

flair.title: Breath
flair.note: held, then out slowly through the mouth

title: hiding
beat: Nadia with her back to the crates, listening, holding her breath. She does not move.
